en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: 'масен мазник' (oiled apron) and 'Генџовчето' (son of Gendzo, or 'the young Gendzo') are my readings. 'Делинасу' and 'Булубаша' are names or titles I do not recognize; I left them transliterated.

lines.cyr: Де мори Васе, Васе, танко Васе,
lines.lat: De mori Vase, Vase, tanko Vase,
lines.en: Come on, hey Vasa, Vasa, slender Vasa,
tuck up, Vasa, your white skirts.
White skirts, Vasa, and sleeves too.

lines.cyr: Де мори засукај, Васе, масен мазник,
lines.lat: De mori zasukaj, Vase, masen maznik,
lines.en: Come on, hey, tuck up, Vasa, your oiled apron,

lines.cyr: ќе ти дојдат, Васе, мили гости.
lines.lat: ḱe ti dojdat, Vase, mili gosti.
lines.en: dear guests will come to you, Vasa.
Osman Beg, Vasa, the son of Gendzo.

lines.cyr: Де мори и со него Васе, и по него,
lines.lat: De mori i so nego Vase, i po nego,
lines.en: Come on, hey, and with him, Vasa, and after him,

lines.cyr: Тебе млада, Васе, да те зема.
lines.lat: Tebe mlada, Vase, da te zema.
lines.en: They will take you as a bride, Vasa.

lines.cyr: Де мори дури речта, Васе, не изрече,
lines.lat: De mori duri rečta, Vase, ne izreče,
lines.en: Come on, hey, before the words, Vasa, were spoken,
Osman Beg, Vasa, the son of Gendzo.
